description: Test suite for group and team command functions in Mattermost's mmctl CLI, including LDAP group listing, team group enabling/disabling, channel group listing, and user group restoration.

classes.name: MmctlUnitTestSuite
classes.description: Test suite struct for unit testing command functions.

methods.name: TestListLdapGroupsCmd
methods.description: Tests for listing LDAP groups, including failure and success scenarios.

methods.name: TestTeamGroupEnableCmd
methods.description: Tests for enabling team group constraints, including error and success cases.

methods.name: TestTeamGroupDisableCmd
methods.description: Tests for disabling team group constraints, including error and success cases.

methods.name: TestChannelGroupListCmd
methods.description: Tests for listing channel groups under various scenarios, including errors and empty results.

methods.name: TestTeamGroupListCmd
methods.description: Tests for listing groups associated with a team, including error handling and successful output.

methods.name: TestTeamGroupStatusCmd
methods.description: Tests for retrieving team group constraint status, including not present, enabled, and disabled states.

methods.name: TestChannelGroupStatusCmd
methods.description: Tests for retrieving channel group constraint status, including error cases and enabled/disabled states.

methods.name: TestChannelGroupEnableCmdF
methods.description: Tests for enabling group constraints on channels, covering various error and success scenarios.

methods.name: TestChannelGroupDisableCmdF
methods.description: Tests for disabling group constraints on channels, including error handling and success.

methods.name: TestUserGroupRestoreCmd
methods.description: Tests for restoring deleted user groups, handling both success and not found errors.
